title: Model A/B fix probe: candidate voice texts for three words that both models misread in model-ab (עשר after ב-, נאמר, עשרות). Each variant by nitzi and hero-son on Turbo and on v4.
note: Ids sort in pairs (09a-hero-turbo, 09a-hero-v4, 09a-nitzi-turbo, 09a-nitzi-v4). Settings are the usual ones. Variants 09c and 11c are rewordings that the hebrew-text-editor and the owner must approve; the others change only the voice text.
